Visitor replaces video with custom link

```typescript title="TypeScript"

function main() {
  const _testVisitor = {
    visitVideo(ctx: unknown, src: unknown): string | { custom: string } {
        return { custom: `[VIDEO: ${src}]` };
    },

    }

  const result = convert("<p>Watch our tutorial:</p><video src=\"tutorial.mp4\" width=\"320\" height=\"240\" controls></video><p>Great content!</p>", { visitor: _testVisitor as never });
```
